title: Cache and refresh
description: Restates HCERT Specification, Appendix A - Trust Management.

statements.label: Cache and refresh
statements.requirement: Trust-list providers that fetch remotely SHALL cache the last good list persistently, SHALL refresh it on a configurable schedule, and SHALL expose when it was last updated so that callers can apply a staleness policy. A failed refresh SHALL keep the last good list.

sources.quote: Verifiers MUST fetch and update this list regularly.
